title: Fridge Door Left Open Risk
dataSources: Sourdough monitor (`sourdough:reading`), BBQ/sous-vide probes (`bbq:probe`), fridge/freezer/oven temperature (`kitchen:appliance`), espresso shots (`espresso:shot`), pantry inventory (`pantry:item`), kombucha brew (`kombucha:reading`).
app: ESP32/ESPHome kitchen sensors (sourdough rise, BBQ/sous-vide probes, fridge/freezer temperature), espresso-shot logs, and pantry inventory via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=kitchen:appliance
| stats latest(door_state) as door_state, latest(open_minutes) as open_minutes, latest(temp_c) as temp_c by appliance
| where door_state="open" AND open_minutes>3
| sort - open_minutes
description: Flags fridges or freezers whose doors remained open long enough to threaten food safety and compressor sanity.
value: Everyone wants this alert about five minutes before it matters, not after the ice cream turns into soup.
implementation: Forward appliance door state and temperature from ESPHome or a smart appliance API; alert when an open-door timer exceeds your threshold.
visualization: Current-state table of kitchen appliances with open minutes and temperature.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks when the fridge or freezer door has been left open long enough to start becoming a problem.
